newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Kidston sees 1996 gold output fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Kidston sees 1996 gold output fall.

text.p: Queensland resources company Kidston Gold Mines Ltd said it produced 44,128 ounces of gold in the December quarter and 185,204 ounces for all of 1996.
This compares with 55,207 ounces and 205,878 ounces in the corresponding periods last year.
Gold production for the quarter and the year was slightly lower than projected and was 10 percent lower than in the 1995 full year, the company said.
Lower mill head grades were the primary reason for production being below estimates and last year's production, Kidston said.
Average head grade for the December quarter was 1.08 grams of gold per tonne and 1.14 grams per tonne for the 12 months.
Recovery rates were 83 percent for the quarter and 81 percent for the year, down from 83 percent for 1995.

Kidston also said an emphasis was placed on regional exploration work during last year, with a focus in the December quarter on the Georgetown/Forsayth region 100 km north-west of its main Kidston mine.

Drilling continued at the Mount Turner and Grey Ghost prospects, with disappointing results, while 37 holes were drilled at the Drummer East prospect during November, the company said. Results from that drilling programme were expected in 1997, it said.
